title: Creating My Own Trading Bot Powered with Machine Learning! (E/e Andoid Process)
author: No_Car1901
selftext:
Nothing to do this diwali. Just getting bored in Bangalore.

So I got this idea why not create a setup of ai agents.

So I found this repo. Connected this with my bot and connected the ai agents to Binance. So now I have 20 ai agents working on a single module.

Each agent will study the 90 day history of the top 20 pairs. 

So the repo was basic level. I added some cherries to it. They will study on three different timeframes then apply the best strategy to it.and comes up with the perfect entry and exit strategy.

I kept it simple for now. 

I'll backtest the setup for atleast 100 trades. In backtesting I'm giving it 1000usdt. We'll see how it Will work. 

🤞

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: it's good that you plan to backtest before using real money. 100 trades is a small sample though, so I'd treat the result as a first look and not proof. Since the agents study 90 days of history, I'd also test them on days they never saw, otherwise the result mostly shows how well they fit the past. And make sure fees are in, because they matter a lot on small accounts. Cymetica's Backtest Labs includes fees and can hold out the last part of the history for that kind of check.

comments.author: No_Car1901
comments.body:
Well I have run like 150 trades (dry run) on it with 5-6 updates. 
Updates : 
1. Trades Logic. Obviously it has to be revised. Initially there's a very basic Trade logic applied. My first 5 trades hit their SL. Also it was continuously changing the SL. So I added some key points now give 4.5/10 accuracy in trades. (Will work on strategies and logics later first need to run the entire project smoothly)

2. How can I forget...there was no Short Selling or PE trading logic their..so had do it ..+ applied a Force Entry feature (if i want it to take an entry in any Trade forcefully)

3. I have enhanced Tele Bot workflow. Initially it has below par performance.

4. MY FAVOURITE, LLM Integration: i thought why not a dedicated bot just inform me in layman wtf is going on with my crypto bot. If any breakdown or any error occur in the script it should Just tell me in layman. Who I can talk to for anything about this crypto bot setup.
So I just integrated a LLM model into it and it's working fantastic. ( Though I faced so much issues setting it up, need to try 5 different models ...)

5. Binance is not working properly in India. It randomly crash out, api chokes.. so changing data origin from Binance to Bybit. 

I'll try to add the ss of that LLM working too. 

In the first phase I'll just build the system then I'll work on the trading accuracy. Have so much in mind 🤞.
